Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#19329
Path: none | 账本记录 145 个键的不授理由 | 先决条件 objectstack-ai/objectstack#19329

## The bucket group

**145 keys** of #19188's 274 need a **recorded reason**, ⛔ never a form row. Offering a control for any of them would itself be the defect. Four sub-buckets, by why they are not authored:

| sub-bucket | count | criterion | what it needs |
|---|---|---|---|
| ADR-0010 provenance / lock overlay | **132** | in the liveness gate's own `FRAMEWORK_FIELDS` set — 7 underscore keys on all 17 forms (119) plus `protection` on 13 | **ONE** recorded reason covering the whole overlay, ⛔ never 132 rows |
| platform-written, never authored | 4 | the schema's own description says the value is not authored (console round-trip state, or machine-managed) | a recorded reason |
| deprecated / legacy alias | 4 | the description carries a bracketed DEPRECATED or LEGACY ALIAS marker | a ledger omit row of the shape the gate already uses — `page.interfaceConfig.sourceView` is the precedent |
| declared, deliberately not enforced yet | 5 | the liveness ledger verdict is `planned` or `experimental` | no offer until it is enforced; the ruling belongs to the enforcement card, ⛔ not to this gate |

Examples: `object._lock` · `field._provenance` · `view.columnState` · `view.isPinned` · `object.titleFormat` · `view.drawerWidth` · `object.externalSharingModel` · `action.onSuccess`.

## ⚠️ This card is blocked in practice, and by what

**Every one of these 145 needs the ledger to accept a top-level coordinate**, which it does not — see the prerequisite card filed alongside. ⇒ this card cannot record its first reason until that lands. It is filed now so the 145 keys are not lost, ⛔ not because it is ready.

## One key whose machine-written status is spelled only in prose

`app._unpublished` is underscore-prefixed and described as 「Machine-managed … Never authored」, but it is **NOT** in the liveness gate's `FRAMEWORK_FIELDS` overlay set and instead carries an ordinary `live` row. Nothing is broken by it today (no gate reads that set for authorability), but it is the one key here whose status no machine reads. Whoever writes the platform-written reason should say what it is.

## Dedup words

`recorded reason not offered` · `FRAMEWORK_FIELDS overlay reason` · `ledger omit row precedent` · `planned experimental no offer` · `app._unpublished framework field`
